transcript: Hey guys, how you doing? This is Coach Brandon here at LHBA and your tip Tuesday today is a hip swivel. Now with the hip swivel is a ball handler's move. This is simply taking your body from a protective standpoint to an optional standpoint. In order to have the options to go either to the right or to the left, you must square up to the basket. So if this ball is my weapon, my body is my shield. So as I'm dribbling this ball with my right hand, I want my left foot in front, knees bent with my shield up to protect the ball. Here's with maximum pressure I have the ball protected. Now when I want to have the option to attack my defender, I want to hip swivel and square up to the basket. Notice that my feet are parallel to the cones here and now I have the option to either drive to the right or drive to the left. So we're simply coming from a protective standpoint, hip swivel into an optional standpoint. So now we can attack to the right or to the left. And this is Coach Brandon here for your tip Tuesday and I'll see you all next week.
